title: Synthetic Optical Coherence Tomography Angiographs for Detailed Retinal Vessel Segmentation Without Human Annotations
mechanism: Lightweight space-colonization simulation of thin vessel networks plus three contrast-adaptation pipelines; a model trained only on simulation segments the finest capillaries better than models trained on human annotations.
adaptation: Moonshot for crack label noise: train the crack class only on procedural/rendered cracks with exact centrelines and per-source widths, keep real labels for other classes, apply contrast adaptation (random gamma, noise, blur matched to the 5 sources); judge on detection within 2 px, not strict IoU.
min_experiment: Arm: PF with crack supervision from synthetic only. Baseline: PF with real crack labels, 5 seeds. Metric: test relF1@2 and recall@2 of low-contrast (< 2%) crack components. Kill: relF1@2 < 0.80.
evidence: R: superior segmentation on three public OCTA sets vs classical methods and human-annotation supervision (abstract; numbers not read); code, models, synthetic set public per abstract.
